library(data.table)
setDTthreads(1)
if (!exists("raw", inherits=FALSE)) {
  files = base::readLines("input-files.txt")
  stopifnot(length(files) == 1231L)
  tables = lapply(files, function(filename) {
    fread(file=filename, skip="gene_id", header=TRUE, showProgress=FALSE)
  })
  raw = list(files=files, tables=setNames(tables, files))
  rm(tables)
}
stopifnot(length(raw$files) == 1231L, length(raw$tables) == 1231L,
          identical(names(raw$tables), raw$files))
reference_ids = raw$tables[[1L]]$gene_id
gene_rows = startsWith(reference_ids, "ENSG")
stopifnot(length(reference_ids) == 60664L, sum(gene_rows) == 60660L,
          identical(which(!gene_rows), 1:4))
total_gene_counts = 0
zero_gene_values = 0
for (i in seq_along(raw$tables)) {
  tab = raw$tables[[i]]
  stopifnot(nrow(tab) == 60664L, ncol(tab) == 9L,
            identical(tab$gene_id, reference_ids), "unstranded" %in% names(tab))
  counts = tab$unstranded[gene_rows]
  stopifnot(is.numeric(counts), all(is.finite(counts)), all(counts >= 0),
            all(counts == floor(counts)))
  total_gene_counts = total_gene_counts + sum(counts)
  zero_gene_values = zero_gene_values + sum(counts == 0)
}
audit = data.frame(n_files=length(raw$files), rows_per_file=60664L,
                   columns_per_file=9L, genes_per_file=sum(gene_rows),
                   total_gene_counts=total_gene_counts, zero_gene_values=zero_gene_values)
fwrite(audit, file="input-audit.csv", row.names=FALSE)
print(audit, digits=17, row.names=FALSE)
cat("All complete tables retained in raw; dimensions, gene ordering, and ENSG counts validated.\n")
EOF
